title: Specified completed mixed map on an integral object
statement: Let l be prime, E,F finite extensions of Q_l and i:E→F an embedding. Let g:X→Y be between noetherian finite-dimensional l-invertible schemes with normalized continuous realizations, Along comparisons agE,agF and FieldChange comparisons bX,bY [def-per-continuous-rational-realization-data]. Let m be any AmbientMixed comparison [lem-per-continuous-ambient-mixed-coherence]. For each integral bounded constructible complete K on Y there is a single raw arrow t from agF.raw(T_Y(QK)) to T_X(agE.raw(QK)), heterogeneously equal to Q_X applied to the actual pbcScalarCompletedPullIso component on K. Its realized image satisfies J_XF(t)≫bX.comparison≫extend(bX.coefficient)(agE.comparison) = agF.comparison≫pullF(bY.comparison)≫m.ambient, evaluated on QK. No naturality or invertibility of t, and no transformation on all raw objects, is asserted.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14(2), Remark 6.8.15; Stacks Tags 0D6D, 0A0E and 0A0G. Expansion of the normalized comparison argument.

proof.text: Take the rationalization of the actual pbcScalarCompletedPullIso component restricted by ObjectProperty.homMk. The endpoints are definitionally the two raw functor objects, so its required heterogeneous equality is HEq.rfl.

Solve Along.completion_unit for P.map(integral.hom)≫ambient≫extend.map(unit), obtaining comparison.inv≫integral.hom. Solve FieldChange.integral_normalization for comparison.hom≫extend.map(integral.hom), obtaining integral.hom≫integralBalance. Naturality of the two reduction normalizations gives naturality of integralBalance.

Postcompose the requested realized equation by scalar extension of comparison.inv≫integral.hom on the E completed pullback. This is an isomorphism. The left side reduces by scalar normalization and naturality of the F integral comparison to integral.hom≫extend.map(published completed component)≫integralBalance. On the right move integral.hom through m.ambient by naturality, apply scalar normalization at Y and the ordinary balancing cube, then move the E completion unit through integralBalance. The published scalarCompletedPull_unit equation turns the integral ordinary comparison followed by scalar extension of the E unit into the F unit followed by the completed component. Along normalization for F now cancels its comparison and yields exactly the same expression. Cancel the common postcomposition.

proof_origin.place: U5: explicit rationalized component and complete naturality/normalization/unit cancellation; only the ordinary ambient tensor cube remains separate. BS Remark 6.8.15 and Stacks Tag 0D6D.

theorem continuousMixedIntegralComponent (i : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] F)
    {X Y : Base.{u} l} (g : X.scheme ⟶ Y.scheme)
    (aXE : At l E X) (aYE : At l E Y) (aXF : At l F X) (aYF : At l F Y)
    (agE : Along l E g aXE aYE) (agF : Along l F g aXF aYF)
    (bX : FieldChange l E F i X aXE aXF) (bY : FieldChange l E F i Y aYE aYF)
    (m : AmbientMixed l E F i g aXE aYE aXF aYF agE agF bX bY)
    (K : PbcBoundedConstructibleComplete Y.scheme (pbcIntegralDatum l E)) :
    ∃ t : (agF.raw l F).obj
        ((pbcRationalScalarExtension l E F i Y.scheme Y.dimension Y.prime_unit).obj
          ((pbcRationalization Y.scheme (pbcIntegralDatum l E) (pbcUniformizer l E)).obj K)) ⟶
      (pbcRationalScalarExtension l E F i X.scheme X.dimension X.prime_unit).obj
        ((agE.raw l E).obj
          ((pbcRationalization Y.scheme (pbcIntegralDatum l E) (pbcUniformizer l E)).obj K)),
    HEq t
      ((pbcRationalization X.scheme (pbcIntegralDatum l F) (pbcUniformizer l F)).map
        (ObjectProperty.homMk
          (X := (integralPull l F g agF.integral_mem).obj
            ((pbcEmbeddingIntegralTensor l E F i Y.scheme Y.dimension Y.prime_unit).obj K))
          (Y := (pbcEmbeddingIntegralTensor l E F i X.scheme X.dimension X.prime_unit).obj
            ((integralPull l E g agE.integral_mem).obj K))
          ((pbcScalarCompletedPullIso l E F i g).hom.app K.obj))) ∧
    aXF.J.map t ≫
        bX.comparison.hom.app ((agE.raw l E).obj
          ((pbcRationalization Y.scheme (pbcIntegralDatum l E) (pbcUniformizer l E)).obj K)) ≫
        (pbcDerivedExtend bX.coefficient).map (agE.comparison.hom.app
          ((pbcRationalization Y.scheme (pbcIntegralDatum l E) (pbcUniformizer l E)).obj K)) =
      agF.comparison.hom.app
          ((pbcRationalScalarExtension l E F i Y.scheme Y.dimension Y.prime_unit).obj
            ((pbcRationalization Y.scheme (pbcIntegralDatum l E) (pbcUniformizer l E)).obj K)) ≫
        (derivedPull g agF.coefficient).map (bY.comparison.hom.app
          ((pbcRationalization Y.scheme (pbcIntegralDatum l E) (pbcUniformizer l E)).obj K)) ≫
        m.ambient.hom.app (aYE.J.obj
          ((pbcRationalization Y.scheme (pbcIntegralDatum l E) (pbcUniformizer l E)).obj K))
